RCA (rebar-debug Phase 1 complete) — CONFIRMED, defect (latent), classification: design-invariant violation / codec seam never wired into the comment differ.

ROOT CAUSE (proven): outbound_comments._diff_comments derives its two dedup keys through DIFFERENT transformations, and the local-side key never passes through the codec's outbound content normalization that the send path's landed form embodies.
- Jira-side key = decode(stored wire form): outbound_comments.py:296 -> _normalize_comment_body (py:113) -> inbound_fields.normalize_rich_text (inbound_fields.py:134-146: ADF dict -> adf_to_text; str -> pass-through).
- Local-side key = fit_comment(marker-strip(str(raw))): outbound_comments.py:314 — truncation ONLY, no normalize_outbound. Mismatch re-emits at outbound_comments.py:319, every pass, forever.
- The description path composes the protection the comment path lacks: outbound_mapper.py:77 normalize_outbound(fit_outbound(v)) — send value is its own round-trip fixed point — and the differ compares exactly that value (outbound_field_diff.py:277-292; reconcile_check.py:194-198). Pinned by test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py:48.

MECHANISM: for any codec/converter whose outbound content transform is not the identity, the body Jira stores decodes to normalize_outbound(sent) while the local key stays the raw text; membership test at outbound_comments.py:315 fails, the differ re-emits the already-mirrored comment, and each new copy stores the SAME transformed form, so it never converges (no self-heal).

WHY LATENT TODAY (verified): Cloud send is acli_cli_ops.add_comment (py:479) = truncation only, rebar computes no ADF for comments; DC WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound is identity (rich_text.py:96). Whether ACLI's own text->ADF rejoins soft wraps remains an OPEN live question — if it does, this is firing on Cloud now.

DISCRIMINATING EXPERIMENTS (unit-level, real _diff_comments + real inbound_fields.normalize_rich_text + real Cloud fit_comment; simulated store; no live Jira):
- Fixture: local body 'first line of prose\nsoft-wrapped continuation' — rebar's own adf.text_to_adf (py:275) rejoins soft wraps, so decode(encode(v)) != v.
- E1 (H1 true): pass 1 emits the add; simulate a transforming send (store = text_to_adf(sanitized sent body)); pass 2 RE-EMITS the mirrored comment (1 mutation); pass 3 with both stored copies STILL re-emits — H4 'self-heals' REJECTED. Keys: jira='first line of prose soft-wrapped continuation' vs local='first line of prose\nsoft-wrapped continuation' — divergence is exactly the soft-wrap rejoin.
- E2 (H3 rejected — latency proven): identical cycle but store preserves text verbatim (hardBreak ADF, and DC plain-string): 0 mutations both — dedup converges today; also proves the RECONCILER_MARKER strip is not a confound.
- E3 (H2 rejected — asymmetry real): same fixture as a description through OutboundFieldMapper(AdfCodec()): send value == decode(encode(send value)) — fixed point, converges.
- E4 (the missing half named): routing the local key through AdfCodec().normalize_outbound first makes it equal the Jira-side key.
- Existing suite green (19 passed: test_outbound_differ_comment_dedup.py, test_diff_comments_adf.py, test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py) — every current dedup test uses round-trip-identity fixtures, so this cell is genuinely untested.

AUTHORITATIVE SOURCES (defect, not not-a-bug): the convergence invariant is documented and enforced for every OTHER transform on this exact key derivation — truncation guard at outbound_comments.py:307-313 ('apply the SAME shared truncation... otherwise... re-emits forever', bug 6afc), DC parity pin backend.py:239-243 ('MUST stay byte-identical... or the loop never converges'), description composition comment outbound_mapper.py:63-82, and prior fixed same-class bugs 85a1/1f3d/4292. The normalization half of the same rule is the un-paired remainder.

SIBLING CANDIDATES (same send-value/compare-key asymmetry class; named, not filed):
1. _map_comments_for_create (outbound_comments.py:80) — create-path comments land through the same transforming send; next-pass dedup of those bodies hits this same broken key (same mechanism, second entry point).
2. Title/summary compare (outbound_field_diff.py:266-271, outbound_mapper 'summary'=raw value): compare key is the raw local title guarded only by _text_matches rstrip (py:49-54); any remote summary content transform beyond trailing whitespace reopens the identical shape. Latent-latent; name only.
3. The inbound comment mirror is ID-bound (inbound_differ.py:299-346, jira_comment_id) — protected by identity binding, NOT a sibling; noted as the contrast case.
4. The codec-law gap itself: no test pins normalize_outbound(t) == decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) for RichTextCodec impls (rich_text.py:43/96, rich_text_codec.py) — a pandoc WikiTextCodec violating it would pass today's suite (ticket AC #4).

PHASE-2 SKETCH: expose the codec's outbound normalization to the comment differ through the ticket-21ca injection seam (extend the injected sanitizer port — e.g. FieldSanitizer.normalize_comment -> codec.normalize_outbound; Cloud: adf.normalize_description, DC: identity) and derive the local key as the composition the SEND path actually lands (mirror the send order: decorate/truncate-then-normalize, marker-strip after — get the order right the way outbound_mapper.py:63-82 documents fit-before-normalize, and pin it with a heldout composition test like test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py:48). Jira-side key unchanged (already decode). Also pin the codec law normalize_outbound(t)==decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) per impl, plus a corpus fixed-point property test over real comment bodies (AC #3/#4), and document the symmetric-degradation invariant (AC #5).

SUGGESTED RED ORACLE (fails today at outbound_comments.py:314-319): unit test in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/ — given an injected sanitizer/codec whose outbound transform is NOT identity (soft-wrap rejoin) and a Jira snapshot holding exactly what that send path stores for the local comment (decorated, truncated, encoded via text_to_adf), _diff_comments emits ZERO adds. Today it emits one (E1b). Negative control: the E2 verbatim-store cell stays zero-mutation.

Experiments were run from throwaway scripts (removed); no tracked file was modified. Phase 2 not started per session scope.
